0063537b  b8 54 c6 81 00   mov     eax, 0x81c654  ; CMapSceneryComponent tick callback (map component vtable +0x08).

CORRECTION PROVEN THIS SLICE: the per-child out-flag this loop checks is a REMOVE/DESTROY signal,
NOT an "insert into the active render deque" signal. An earlier reading had it backwards, and the
managed port inherited that error.

Sequence:
  0x6353A9  MotionPathNodeDeque_ClearAndResetCursors(this + 0x74)  - clears the ACTIVE render deque
  0x6353B5  sub_641D2C(this + 0x34, &copy)                         - snapshots the LOADED deque
  loop over the snapshot; per child: eax_4 = child->vtable[0x0C]() (CMapObj::GetObjType)

Dispatch by type code:
  == 0x01  0x635475  child->Tick(nullptr)                      - no removal check
  == 0x04  0x635456  hero = CHero_GetSingletonPtr()->vtable[0x10](&pair); child->Tick(&pair)
                                                               - NO removal check, and NO forced
                                                                 active-render insert. Type 04
                                                                 self-registers from inside its own
                                                                 tick (CMapType3SubcomponentType04_Tick
                                                                 -> CGameMap_NotifySceneryComponentSubcomponentUpdated
                                                                 at 0x645625), gated on a SECOND
                                                                 on-screen test that uses the stored
                                                                 tile pair this+0x0C/+0x10.
  <= 0x05,
  <= 0x07  child->Tick(arg2)                                   - no removal check
  == 0x09  child->Tick(0); remove if child[0x28] != 0
  == 0x0A  0x6354A9  child->Tick(&flag); remove if flag != 0
  == 0x0E,
  == 0x11  0x6354A9  same flag form
  == 0x13  0x635484  child->Tick(arg2); remove if sub_733041(child) != 0
  default  0x635475  child->Tick(nullptr)

"Remove" is CMapSceneryComponent_DetachAndRemoveSubcomponent (0x6355E7):
  - CMapSceneryComponent_RemoveFromActiveRenderDequeAndType2Parents (0x635710)
      erases the child from the active deque at +0x74 (remove/erase pair ending in
      StdDequePtr_EraseRange), then, when the child's own type code != 2, walks the active deque
      and calls CMapSceneryType2Subcomponent_RemoveChild (0x644D83) on every type-2 entry, which
      erases the child from that entry's +0x88 child list
  - sub_6415A6(this + 0x34) removes it from the loaded-subcomponent index
  - type 0x01 then runs the terrain-group teardown, type 0x11 the +0x0C list teardown

Read the 0x0A case against CMapType3SubcomponentType0A_Tick to see why: the flag it writes is the
effect object's update state code, so nonzero means the effect FINISHED. It is then suppressed by
`if (this[0x1C] == 0) flag = 0`, i.e. an effect flagged inactive is never torn down. Force-drawing
a finished effect would be the opposite of what the branch does.

Consequence for parity: entries reach the ACTIVE deque only by self-registering through
CGameMap_NotifySceneryComponentSubcomponentUpdated during their own tick, never by a decision this
loop makes. This loop only ticks and reaps.
